Budgeted revenue expenditure by authority and service, Cardiff (StatsWales; row labels revised 4 September 2026)

gla_split.label: Police
gla_split.official_term: South Wales Police and Crime Commissioner's precept
gla_split.method_note: Composition of average band D council tax: police council tax within the county area, this year and last.

others.name: South Wales Police
others.to: the South Wales Police and Crime Commissioner, for policing

parish.names: Lisvane, Old St Mellons, Pentyrch, Radyr and Morganstown, St Fagans and Tongwynlais
parish.method_note: Budget requirement (BR1): community council precepts. The council names the councils that set one.

bill.method_note: Council and police Band D from StatsWales's composition of Band D; every band is Band D times the Welsh ratio (A to I). Outside a community council.

funding.label: Council tax
funding.official_term: Amount to be collected from council tax payers
funding.desc: What residents pay through the council's part of the bill, after Council Tax Reduction, including what it passes on to community councils
funding.method_note: StatsWales financing of revenue expenditure, 2026-27 budget: amount to be collected from council tax payers.

funding.label: Revenue Support Grant
funding.desc: The council's main general grant from the Welsh Government, which also pays for Council Tax Reduction
funding.method_note: StatsWales financing of revenue expenditure, 2026-27 budget: revenue support grant.

funding.label: Business rates (Wales's shared pot)
funding.official_term: Share of re-distributed non-domestic rates, less discretionary relief
funding.desc: Business rates are pooled across Wales and shared out per head of population, so this is not what local businesses pay; less the rate relief the council gives
funding.method_note: StatsWales financing of revenue expenditure, 2026-27 budget: share of re-distributed non-domestic rates and discretionary non-domestic rate relief.

funding.label: Specific government grants
funding.desc: Grants for particular purposes, such as housing benefit and schools; the return does not say which services each pays for
funding.method_note: StatsWales financing of revenue expenditure, 2026-27 budget: specific grants.

funding.label: Drawn from council reserves
funding.desc: One-off: once spent, the gap returns the year after
funding.method_note: StatsWales financing of revenue expenditure, 2026-27 budget: appropriations from (+) / to (-) reserves.

services.label: Schools and education
services.desc: Schools' budgets, additional learning needs, school transport, further education and the youth service
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Education. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Care for older and disabled adults
services.desc: Care homes, home care and support for older people and disabled adults
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Service strategy - adults social services; Older people (aged 65 and over) including older mentally ill; Adults aged under 65 with a physical disability or sensory impairment; Adults aged under 65 with learning disabilities; Adults aged under 65  with mental health needs; Other adult social services. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Children's services
services.desc: Children in care, family support, safeguarding, youth justice and Flying Start
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Children's and families services. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Housing and homelessness
services.desc: Homelessness and housing advice, Supporting People, and housing benefit paid out, which government grants largely cover. Council homes are a separate account
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Council fund housing. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Streets, waste and transport
services.official_term: Roads and transport; waste and street cleansing
services.desc: Bins, recycling and waste disposal, street cleaning, roads, street lights, public transport and the airport, after parking income
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Roads and transport; Street cleansing; Waste collection; Waste disposal; Trade waste; Recycling; Waste minimisation; Climate change costs. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Community safety and regulation
services.desc: Environmental health, trading standards, community safety, cemeteries, registration, elections and emergency planning
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Local environmental services; -Street cleansing; -Waste collection; -Waste disposal; -Trade waste; -Recycling; -Waste minimisation; -Climate change costs. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Parks, libraries and leisure
services.official_term: Libraries, culture, heritage, sport and recreation
services.desc: Parks and open spaces, libraries, sport and culture
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Libraries, culture, heritage, sport and recreation. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Planning and the local economy
services.desc: Planning, building control, economic and community development
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Planning, economic and community development. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Running the council
services.official_term: Central administration; local tax collection; other revenue expenditure
services.desc: Finance, IT, legal and democracy, collecting council tax, flood defence, coroners, and the precepts it passes on to community councils
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Central administration; Local tax collection; Other revenue expenditure. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Debt costs and levies
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: Debt financing costs. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.

services.label: Fire and rescue (levy)
services.official_term: Levy to South Wales Fire and Rescue Authority
services.desc: The council's contribution to South Wales Fire and Rescue Service. The return leaves it out of the service lines: it is the budget's gross total less those lines
services.method_note: StatsWales, 2026-27 budget, £ thousand: the financing table's gross revenue expenditure less the spending table's revenue expenditure. Before specific grants, which the return does not split by service.
